name: Tall Box
description: A double-height box that holds 18 marbles and blocks two grid cells until it is emptied.
howToPlay: The sealed column in the middle can only be opened from the bottom. Tap the yellow box at its base, and the green Tall Box above it opens up — one tap pours all 18 marbles and frees BOTH of its cells at once, unlocking the two boxes stacked above. There is also a pink Tall Box on the left you can tap straight away.

showcaseLevel.name: Tall Box Demo
showcaseLevel.desc: One tap, 18 marbles, two cells freed
